verdict.rationale: Cekura stores customer call transcripts and recordings, so data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The pack documents no retention settings or deletion controls. PII redaction (cekura-docs-12/60) is an adjacent control that removes sensitive content, not a retention or deletion policy. The CLI's vague "manage call data" (cekura-docs-4) never mentions deleting data or setting retention periods.
